articles.title: Bonnie Tyler is remembered as worldwide star at her Welsh funeral
articles.summary: SWANSEA, Wales (AP) — Fans crowded outside a Welsh church Monday where family and friends remembered husky-voiced singer Bonnie Tyler as a star loved worldwide.

articles.title: 5 charged, including 2 youths, in fatal double shooting on Brampton school grounds
articles.summary: A 21-year-old and two 17-year-olds from Brampton are facing two charges each of first-degree murder, after a shooting on school grounds in Brampton that took the lives of one man and one youth in April, Peel police say.

articles.title: Supreme Court again rebuffs Trump’s push to toss out $5 million verdict in E. Jean Carroll case
articles.summary: WASHINGTON (AP) — The Supreme Court on Monday again rebuffed President Donald Trump’s push to throw out a jury’s $5 million finding that he sexually abused the writer E. Jean Carroll at a New York City department store in the mid-1990s and later defamed her.
